conventions.convention: E={1,…,r}, r≥2; Gibbs weights are strictly positive; the bidirectional positive-rate graph is connected; detailed balance is π_a w_ab=π_b w_ba. Q acts on column observables, while row probability vectors satisfy p′=pQ.

The Langevin bath tracks one scalar position coordinate along a fixed axis of a fixed Newtonian inertial chart. Its velocity is continuous, position is pathwise C1 almost surely, and σ²=2γk_B T_b/m is adopted rather than deduced from mechanics.

The initial OU velocity is centered Gaussian with variance k_B Θ/m and independent of future Brownian increments. Forcing is deterministic and locally continuous. Diffusion and Gaussian scaling concern centered displacement, not an arbitrary initial position.

Finite-bath equilibrium response starts from π and uses w_ab^ε(t)=w_ab exp(βεh(t)(B_b−B_a)/2). The amplitude ε is dimensionless; h has units joules per unit of B. Absent edges remain absent, and rate ratios are asserted only on positive-rate edges.
C_BA(t)=⟨B−π(B),P_t(A−π(A))⟩_π and R_AB(t)=−βC′_BA(t). The Green–Kubo normalization is covariance divided by 2T, and (−Q)⁻¹ is restricted to mean-zero functions.

Relative information uses 0 log 0=0. Its displayed derivative applies at positive times; the almost-sure averaging conclusion holds for every initial law, while the stated variance bound assumes stationary preparation.
Strong lumpability means one common time-homogeneous coarse generator valid for every microscopic initial law, including point masses. The partition may have one block.

load_bearing.statement: A finite reversible stochastic rate model has r≥2 states, Gibbs weights π_a=Z⁻¹exp(−βe_a), finite nonnegative off-diagonal rates, a connected bidirectional positive-rate graph, detailed balance, and row generator Q_ab=w_ab, Q_aa=−Σ_{b≠a}w_ab.

Under Choice and the finite model hypotheses, every initial probability row vector admits a nonexplosive continuous-time Markov chain with P_t=e^{tQ}; π is stationary, Q is self-adjoint on L²(E,π), its kernel is the constants, and every other eigenvalue is strictly negative. Stationary preparation admits a two-sided stationary extension with locally finite jumps.

Under Choice, the Brownian hypotheses, positive parameters satisfying σ²=2γk_B Θ/m, stationary Gaussian initial velocity independent of future increments, and deterministic locally continuous forcing, the forced OU equation has a unique continuous solution. Its centered integrated velocity is Gaussian with variance 2(k_B Θ/m)[t/γ−(1−exp(−γt))/γ²], diffusion coefficient D=k_B Θ/(mγ), and constant-input response coefficient 1/(mγ).

Under the stated choice and finite reversible model hypotheses, stationary preparation and the specified symmetric exponential perturbation give R_AB(u)=−βC′_BA(u). For bounded vector observables, the stationary integrated covariance divided by 2T converges to D_ij=∫₀∞C_ij(s)ds=⟨(G_c)_i,(−Q)⁻¹(G_c)_j⟩_π, a positive-semidefinite matrix.

Under the stated choice and finite reversible model hypotheses, relative information has the displayed nonpositive dissipation derivative for t>0 and tends to zero. For every bounded observable and every initial law, the continuous-time average converges almost surely to its Gibbs mean.

The projected process has one time-homogeneous Markov generator valid for every microscopic initial probability law if and only if each outgoing block-rate sum q(a,C_j) is constant within its source block. Under this condition the aggregated Gibbs weights satisfy detailed balance.

concerns.concern: The Statement and proof introduction write “V_0∈F_0”. F_0 is a sigma-algebra of events, whereas V_0 is a real random variable. The Facts correctly identify the intended condition as F_0-measurability, so this is a notation/type correction rather than a missing stochastic hypothesis.

alerts.finding: Definition clause 2 states without a positive-rate qualification: “Its normalized post-click state is L_ab|a⟩/‖L_ab|a⟩‖=|b⟩.” The cited thm-qsm-dt-gibbs-jump permits w_ab=0 on absent edges, giving L_ab|a⟩=0 and an undefined quotient. A connected three-state path already supplies such an allowed absent edge. The formula needs its nonzero-outcome condition made explicit.

seams_checked.note: Checked the collision definition against its use in rem-csm-dk-hard-limit-dispositions: homogeneous three-dimensional elastic reflection with a finite normalized angular measure. No microscopic derivation or hydrodynamic-limit theorem is imported.

Checked the periodic mean-field definition against the scope remark: smooth periodic pair force and 1/N interaction scaling. The consumer does not identify this regime with Boltzmann–Grad scaling or infer generic Hamiltonian ergodicity.

The monitored-chain definition cites the finite-chain theorem for exponential holding times, destination probabilities, nonexplosion and e^{tW}. Its Gibbs-jump data satisfy the supplier's finite connected reversible hypotheses, and full Choice is retained. The separate zero-rate normalization issue is recorded as an alert; it is not an overstatement of the cited chain theorem.
